candidates.title: 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski found guilty of fraud at his jury trial in Toronto
candidates.description: Self-described "Crypto King" Aiden Pleterski was found guilty of fraud over $5,000 by the jury at his Toronto trial Thursday morning.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tumbler Ridge shooting survivor Maya Gebala being released from hospital, father says
candidates.description: A 13-year-old girl who was severely injured in the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting is being released from hospital after nearly nine months of uncertain recovery, her father says.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Health-care sectors fear staff shortages after OSAP freezes prompt some private college students to drop out
candidates.description: As many private college students in Ontario put their training on hold due to a freeze in student financial aid, there are concerns a dwindling number of graduates will make it difficult to recruit people for job vacancies in critical health-care sectors.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A mayoral race with 2 Chows caused ballot confusion in Toronto. Can that be fixed?
candidates.description: Olivia Chow won a decisive victory against Brad Bradford to hold on to her job as mayor for another term, but a third-place finisher who got thousands of votes in the municipal race is prompting questions around whether there was confusion at the polls.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Belleville, Ont., police officer who thwarted synagogue attack released from hospital
candidates.description: The Belleville, Ont., police department says Const. Jeff Smith has been released from hospital more than a month after he was shot and seriously injured in a shootout near a synagogue.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Joly says she'll meet with Stelco owner if company gives 'concrete' plan to bring workers back
candidates.description: In a letter to Stelco's president dated Thursday, Industry Minister Mélanie Joly said she would meet with the company but first wanted to see a solid plan to bring back workers who are off the job. The letter is the most recent back-and-forth between the American owners of the Hamilton steel plant and the federal government.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: At 71, this B.C. man has donated blood 500 times. He hopes others will consider rolling up their sleeves
candidates.description: According to Canadian Blood Services, one in two Canadians will need blood or blood products at some point in their life, or know somebody who will need it. And while about half of all Canadians are eligible to donate blood, only about one in 76 actually do, it says.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New details emerge in death of 4-year-old Inuk girl in care of Montreal youth protection
candidates.description: Quebec’s health authority has launched a major investigation into the care of Montreal's English youth protection system after three deaths of children in their care in March 2026.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. tariffs loom large over Ontario’s annual budget as first look shows $16.9B deficit
candidates.description: Ontario’s mini-budget projects a larger than expected deficit, partly due to tariff impacts, and extends the timeline to get the province’s finances back into the black.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta-made low-tech tractor getting attention worldwide
candidates.description: A small agricultural service shop in central Alberta has developed an all-mechanical tractor that promises low-cost reliability and ease of repair in a sector where most machinery has become increasingly high-tech and often includes computer servicing contracts. Ursa Ag in Bowden is fielding inquiries from across North America.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 4 in hospital as Toronto police investigate shooting in home
candidates.description: Toronto police say they're investigating a home invasion after three people were shot inside a North York residence early Thursday. They say four people were injured, and two are in life-threatening condition.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Residents of northern Ontario town frustrated with proposed mine that would force them to relocate
candidates.description: If plans to develop a northeastern Ontario mine go ahead, the roughly 500 residents of Virginiatown will need to be relocated to nearby communities.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Edmonton and Calgary rejected her referendum. Does Danielle Smith have a city problem?
candidates.description: Nowhere in Alberta was the idea of a second referendum less popular than in urban centres. A year out from an election, Premier Danielle Smith says she's committed to identifying the issues important to urban voters and "prioritizing them in a serious way."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: More Canadian provinces are ending time changes. What does it mean for your health?
candidates.description: Researchers are raising concerns as parts of Canada move to permanent daylight time, warning that later winter sunrises could have consequences for sleep and health.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian sliding sports to unite under one umbrella
candidates.description: Bobsleigh Skeleton Canada and Luge Canada will come together as one organization, uniting three sliding sports under one umbrella, the organizations announced on Thursday. It comes as national sport organizations are encouraged to consider amalgamation and sharing services to create more sustainable organizations.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Next Gen’ athlete program to get $10M funding boost from feds, COC, CPC pledge fundraising to match
candidates.description: The federal government is doubling its investment in the Next Gen program from $5 million to $10 million, it announced on Thursday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hamilton bar dresses up as The Simpsons' Moe's Tavern for Halloween
candidates.description: From dressing up their beers, redesigning their menu, to modifying their front sign, Leipurts and his wife, Jenna Firsht spent about a month planning and transforming the Barton Street space and ended up altering around 75 per cent of the interior decoration.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario to provide fiscal update as tariff fight bites into budget
candidates.description: Ontario will provide a key economic update Thursday after repeated warnings from the province’s treasurer that its mini-budget will be awash in red ink.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: He tried to get into Montreal's kosher market. It led to a battle over alleged meat monopoly
candidates.description: Mendy Boyarsky alleges the Jewish Community Council of Montreal (JCC) is using its market dominance to limit competition to the kosher meat market through its certifier, Montreal Kosher, known as MK Kosher. He asked the federal Competition Tribunal to step in. The JCC, which runs MK Kosher, denies the allegations.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dirty tricks or much ado about nothing? Why Alaska, for once, is front and centre in midterms
candidates.description: Could a manoeuvre reportedly plotted by officials connected to Democratic candidate Mary Peltola backfire and cost the party in its attempt to regain control of the Senate in next week's midterms? Here's a look at the controversy surrounding two candidates named Dan Sullivan on the Senate ballot.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New Call of Duty game under fire for using footage of deadly 2022 South Korea crowd crush
candidates.description: The families of people killed in a deadly crowd crush in South Korea are calling on the makers of the latest Call of Duty video game to remove footage it used from the 2022 incident that left 160 people dead and nearly 200 more injured.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump's increasing support for Russia carries existential danger for Canada
candidates.description: Some analysts say U.S. President Donald Trump's recent rapprochement with Russia poses a clear danger to Canadians — one not easily solved by closer partnerships with allies an ocean away.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Spanish rescue workers search for any survivors in high-speed rail crash, with 69 dead
candidates.description: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, in which one train struck another from behind, killing 69 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network ahead of a national election.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. midterms could be the country's most expensive elections yet. To what end?
candidates.description: The 2026 U.S. midterms are shaping up to be the most expensive elections in the country's history. Just how much will campaign money play a role in determining who wins? Here's a closer look.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why none of the EU's existing partnerships are the right fit for Canada
candidates.description: The European Union has a number of partnership deals with non-member countries, but Canada won't fit into any of those existing frameworks. A Montreal summit this week will launch formal discussions and negotiations about a new partnership to bring Canada closer to the EU.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Netanyahu's party amplifies unproven claims that Arab-led parties have ‘stolen' Israel's election
candidates.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party on Thursday amplified unsubstantiated allegations that Arab-led parties had "stolen" the election, potentially with foreign assistance, as final results were expected to confirm Netanyahu's bloc had lost its majority in parliament.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
candidates.description: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people on a crowded rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro on Thursday, and five in daytime strikes on two other cities, officials said, even as a local truce in Kherson raised cautious hopes for a resumption of diplomacy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Arab parties offer Israel's political leaders a path to victory. Why does no one want to take it?
candidates.description: The two front-runners after Israel's election don’t have the parliamentary seats for a workable majority and only one choice to get that support, a choice considered politically distasteful among many Jewish voters — to join with Arab parties.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Personal data of 40,000 U.S. Homeland Security employees leaked in security breach
candidates.description: The leak website Distributed Denial of Secrets said on ‌Wednesday it has released data on more than 40,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security employees, including details about officials working in sensitive fields such as surveillance and human intelligence.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dolores Huerta, U.S. labour leader and civil rights icon, dead at 96
candidates.description: Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in fruit and vegetable fields in the United States and coined the enduring "Sí, se puede!" rallying cry, has died. She was 96.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: EU dropping associate membership title for its closer alliance with Canada
candidates.description: The words "associate membership" were removed from a joint statement expected to be released at this week's Canada-EU summit, according to a draft seen by CBC News.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Calgary-developed wound treatment used on battlefields in Ukraine
candidates.description: An innovative wound and burn treatment initially funded by Canada's Department of National Defence is now being delivered by drone to help wounded soldiers and civilians in war-torn Ukraine.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Most nations at UN vote to condemn U.S. embargo on Cuba
candidates.description: The United Nations General Assembly overwhelmingly urged an ‌end to the decades-long U.S. economic embargo on Cuba on Wednesday, but a U.S. lobbying push led several countries to oppose the resolution or abstain for the first time in years.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Game 6 of the WNBA Finals starts at 12:30 p.m. ET tomorrow. How did this happen?
candidates.description: CBC Sports' daily newsletter breaks down the scheduling fiasco that caused Game 6 of the WNBA Finals to be moved to a weekday afternoon, and what it means for a league that can't seem to avoid controversy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nearly 6 million people facing severe hunger in Haiti
candidates.description: Nearly six million people in Haiti are experiencing severe hunger, with almost two million facing emergency conditions, according to a new report released Wednesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New Vera C. Rubin telescope spots possible new dwarf planet beyond Pluto
candidates.description: Scientists using a Chile-based telescope have identified an icy object orbiting beyond Pluto ‌that may join our solar system's small roster of dwarf planets.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Election denial has gone mainstream in the U.S. What does that mean for the midterms?
candidates.description: The 2026 midterms are taking place amid attempts by the White House to use election fraud as a pretext to rewrite election rules. County clerks and voter-rights advocates are seeking ways to safeguard the results.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after fleeing Brazil
candidates.description: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami on Wednesday after he refused to concede the election to President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and fled the country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cruise billed as floating home suspends global voyage over fuel costs, stranding passengers
candidates.description: A U.S. cruise ship on an around-the-world voyage that touted its cabins as floating homes suspended its three-year voyage in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada to invest up to $1.6B in Toronto-based AI company Cohere
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says his government will invest up to $1.6 billion in Canadian AI company Cohere.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rogers hit with $15M fine over 'deceptive' marketing of 'Infinite' phone plan
candidates.description: Rogers Communications has been ordered to pay a $15-million fine by Canada's Competition Bureau related to an "Infinite" cell phone plan.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: BMO, CIBC, RBC, TD Bank block personal AI agents, citing safety and security
candidates.description: Some of Canada's biggest banks say they will block AI agents like Meta’'s popular Muse assistant from directly accessing accounts and other information of their clients.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: DoorDash to buy rival Instacart for $17B US as it bets on grocery delivery
candidates.description: Rising cost pressures and tough regulatory scrutiny over the treatment of gig workers have spurred deals in the industry, with many smaller players being eaten up by competitors in recent years.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Higher mortgage costs set to depress already 'bleak' housing market
candidates.description: The Bank of Canada's first rate hike in three years will boost borrowing costs, weighing on an already battered real estate market. Rates for variable mortgage holders and those with new fixed rate mortgages will see higher monthly payments as a result.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 46% of Canadian CEOs eyeing AI-driven growth with smaller staff, poll shows
candidates.description: A poll of 50 CEOs of large Canadian companies shows nearly half are eyeing smaller, more productive workforces with the help of AI.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Smaller airlines ask Transport Canada for pilots' shifts to last up to 14 hours
candidates.description: At least 18 carriers are asking the federal government to extend their pilots' maximum flight duty period by an hour a day, saying the current rules prevent them from managing the frequent delays that disrupt air travel in the North.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
candidates.description: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
candidates.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
candidates.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
candidates.description: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
candidates.description: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
candidates.description: With 99% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate
candidates.description: The Republican governor was responding to allegations in the New York Times that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate, Dan Sullivan.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
candidates.description: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
candidates.description: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Audacious Indian jailbreak saga ends with 17 prisoners recaptured
candidates.description: The jailbreak began with a fake seizure and ended 36 hours later with all the inmates back behind bars.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'Like cutting up a Picasso': AI microdrama edit of Neighbours worries actors and crew
candidates.description: A micro-drama will use AI-assisted technology to edit old episodes of the Australian TV soap to focus on Margot Robbie's character.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: King dances in the streets of the Bahamas capital
candidates.description: The monarch is in the Bahamas as part of a tour of the Caribbean during which he addressed the "great suffering of the past".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
candidates.description: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What we know so far about deadly Spain train crash
candidates.description: More than 500 passengers were on board the trains when the crash occurred in the province of Toledo, south of Madrid.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
candidates.description: With more than 90% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ofcom outlines age check methods ahead of social media ban for under-16s
candidates.description: Ofcom says photo and digital ID, banking checks or facial age estimation can help prove someone is 16 or over.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Microsoft profits soar days after announcing thousands of layoffs
candidates.description: The week, the Windows developer said it would offer buyouts to 60,000 workers as it looks to curb costs.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Weather warning lifted as third storm to hit Scotland eases off
candidates.description: Energy provider SSEN says 2,000 properties in the north of Scotland are still without power after days of high winds and heavy rain.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Mini-gardens for bees on bus stop roofs approved
candidates.description: Living Roofs aimed at boosting biodiversity in urban areas will be installed under a new bus stop contract.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What killed 500-plus penguins? How scientists solved the mystery
candidates.description: The penguins that perished lived on the Danger Islands in Antarctica. The prime suspect was avian flu. Researchers were surprised by what they found.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: US and Japan agree to establish a Japanese facility for joint missile production
candidates.description: The announcement Wednesday is the latest action by the allies, who have repeatedly expressed alarm over China's growing assertiveness in Asia.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: China elevates a military general to the Politburo and seeks to strengthen party discipline
candidates.description: This move comes about a year before President Xi Jinping is expected to secure his fourth five-year term.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Greetings from Baghdad, where Agatha Christie's old home presents its own mystery
candidates.description: The English writer visited Iraq multiple times in the first half of the 20th century and set some of her mystery novels there. The house in Baghdad where she once lived now sits abandoned and crumbling.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
candidates.description: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
candidates.description: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
candidates.description: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
candidates.description: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
candidates.description: Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, and the results remain too close to call. And, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak was first declared in May.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
candidates.description: The toll is rising after a high-speed train between slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped south of Madrid, derailing two cars. It was Spain's second major train accident this year.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
candidates.description: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
candidates.description: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
candidates.description: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
candidates.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
candidates.description: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Lost your spark? The "silent sister" of depression, and a quiz to spot her
candidates.description: Always busy, but rarely joyful? Allison Aubrey and Juana Summers discuss a tool to spot "high functioning depression."
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Ahead of midterms, Missourians defend transgender healthcare
candidates.description: The campaign to defend access to transgender healthcare for young people in Missouri is taking an unhurried approach to talking with voters about the proposed ban.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: New blood test can detect changes associated with Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: Brain changes associated with Alzheimer's disease can be detected by a new type of blood test -- and a growing number of patients are asking their doctors about it.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Eleven states cut Medicaid coverage for refugees who are pregnant or children
candidates.description: When Congress cut Medicaid benefits for refugees who are in the U.S. legally, most states allowed them to continue for children and pregnant women. Arizona and 10 others did not.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trump administration will allow pharmacies to make popular peptides
candidates.description: The Department of Health and Human Services will let small compounding pharmacies make six peptides that haven't been approved by the Food and Drug Administration. It may not be enough to meet demand.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Are you an organ donor? Here are some rule changes you may want to know
candidates.description: Transplant teams can talk to families about organ donation before they've decided whether to continue life-sustaining medical care for loved ones. Until now, that has been forbidden.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.description: The Flood Advisory will expire at 515 PM AST this afternoon for Camuy, Hatillo, Lares, Las Marias and San Sebastian. The heavy rain has ended. Flooding is no longer expected to pose a threat. Please continue to heed remaining road closures.

candidates.title: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 29 at 2:43PM MDT until October 30 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Great Falls MT
candidates.description: * WHAT...Visibility one quarter to one half mile in dense freezing fog. * WHERE...Gates of the Mountains, Cascade County below 5000ft, Eastern Glacier, Western Toole, and Central Pondera, Eastern Pondera and Eastern Teton, Northern High Plains, and Southern High Plains. * WHEN...Until noon MDT Friday. * IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some roadways or bridges could be frost covered and slippery.
candidates.author: National Weather Service

candidates.title: M 6.4 - southeast of Easter Island
candidates.description: The United States Geological Survey reported an earthquake of magnitude 6.4. The event occurred near southeast of Easter Island. Official monitoring data may be updated as scientists review additional measurements.
candidates.author: U.S. Geological Survey
